'''Wurrooba''' was a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] who worked for [[Starwind Chandlery]], a small general store and [[Starship/Legends|starship]] outfitter, that was located in the market of the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[StarForge Station]],<ref name="Orbit" /> as of [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].<ref name="Date">{{FarOrbitDate}}</ref> Wurrooba, along with a [[Human/Legends|Human]] named [[Mioe]], clerked the store, while the [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Labio]] managed it.<ref name="Orbit" />

==Behind the scenes==
Wurrooba first appeared in ''[[Preparing for War]]'', an adventure scenario from [[1998]]'s ''[[The Far Orbit Project]]'', by [[Timothy S. O'Brien]]. The book was a supplement to [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' and was a sequel of sorts to the previous publication, ''[[Pirates & Privateers]]'', carrying on that book's theme by following the [[Privateer/Legends|privateering]] [[Frigate/Legends|vessel]] ''[[Far Orbit]]''. ''The Far Orbit Project'' did not provide a gender for Wurrooba.
